subject: design/review-feedback-capture
statement: a **registry-born docgate check** (`check-review-feedback-resolution`, extending `distributed-check-registration`) fails any entry `outcome` ref or `Learned-from: review-thread` ref that does not resolve — moving the FR-4/M4 provenance guarantee from convention to gate (AP-10).
